From: Samira Khan <samira.k@vertexai.com>

Cc: David Hsu <david.hsu@vertexai.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Intro — Redwood demo, VP/CIO alignment?

Hi Marissa,

Quick intro — I’m Samira (VP Product at Vertex AI). We’ve been evaluating inference platforms and Redwood came up strongly from a few engineering partners. I’m coordinating schedules with our CIO (David Hsu) and our VP Eng to get an exec-level demo focused on latency, multi-region routing, and private deployment controls.

Key asks for the session:
- High-level architecture for private deployments (VPC/on-prem)
- Demonstration of SLA/fallback routing for a hybrid workload
- Rough unit-cost/throughput numbers for a 1M-token/day workload

We have a narrow exec window on the 21st (afternoon PT) and prefer a compact 30–45 minute run with time boxed Q&A. Can you share availability and whether you can include someone from your dedicated capacity team? Also happy to share a short list of preliminary questions (attached).

Thanks —
Samira Khan
VP, Product
Vertex AI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — Redwood demo, VP/CIO alignment?

Samira — great to meet you over email and thanks for the context. Short answer: yes, we can run a tightly scoped 30–45 minute exec briefing and include an engineer from our Dedicated/Private team for the VPC coverage sections.

Proposed slots (PT):
1) Wed 21 Jun — 1:00–1:35 PM PT
2) Wed 21 Jun — 3:00–3:40 PM PT

Ben and Priyom are copied to help with the technical runbook and to cover recording/ops. I attached a one‑page proposed agenda to keep the demo focused. If David can share availability, we’ll pin the invite and send a concise run-of-show.

Notes: we call out the exact model variants and latency numbers in the appendix so we don’t have to go too deep during the exec slot. Also happy to compress to 30 minutes if you prefer an extremely tight window.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
